# Keentel General Contractors

> Licensed general contractor (CGC, CPC, CFC) providing residential, commercial, and industrial construction, electrical contracting, design-build, and 24/7 emergency restoration services throughout Florida, including Hillsborough, Pinellas, Pasco, Polk, Manatee, Sarasota, Citrus, and Hernando counties.

## Key Services
- General construction (residential & commercial)
- Design-build services
- Electrical contracting (residential, commercial, industrial)
- Emergency restoration (fire, storm, flood damage)
- Remodeling and additions
- Insurance claim assistance
- Permit and code compliance
